state: Frozen source inventory; integrated implementation and verification pending
decisions: Ordinary explicitly requested chat and public research begin on Send without separate assignment preflight; consequential actions, publication and new permissions retain approval.
No standalone rewrite users, data, credentials, sessions, schedules, approvals or execution state are imported. Preserve Deep data and leave donor services untouched.
Redesigned web first; preserve current native compatibility. Windows, Android and Apple/wrist redesign remains required in a later milestone.
Reuse institutional Keycloak realm Astral, existing verified subject ownership, client registrations and Deep provider credential separation.

capabilities.required_adaptation: Map verified context and immutable intent into one existing dispatch path. Preserve origin and refusals without parallel execution.
Adopt queued/active/wait/authority/budget/retry/reconciliation/terminal meanings and cancel/pause/resume/wait/wake/delete controls; maintain current native protocol.
Retain operation/attempt/delivery separation, pagination, sequence cursors, resync and bounded SSE/polling. Reconnect cannot duplicate an effect.
Adopt atomic reservation/settlement, heartbeat fences, cancellation and retry classification through Plane. Unknown external effects require reconciliation, not replay.

capabilities.capability: Ordinary chat and first useful submission
capabilities.required_adaptation: Send starts ordinary work immediately. Preserve existing multi-turn conversation and tool planning; donor single-turn chat is not a replacement. Guidance binding stays deterministic without mandatory preflight.
Adopt source attribution, completeness, citation/envelope validation and insufficient-evidence outcomes; retain existing search discovery and refetch ephemeral evidence on retry.

capabilities.capability: Exact result proposals and saved artifacts
capabilities.required_adaptation: Map owner/revision/digest/target/expiry/one-use approval and deterministic publication to existing artifacts/workspaces. Preserve existing artifact types and sharing policy.
Adopt interval schedule lifecycle, run allowances, pause/resume/Stop and outstanding-episode fences. Keep existing cron and one-shot schedules. Correct cross-owner scan starvation.
Add complete-source fingerprints, grounded initial observations, prior-episode binding, unchanged-source generation avoidance and meaningful-change results. Do not import donor schedules/cursors.
Adopt draft/revise/activate/archive/clone, immutable revisions, preview and current-agent binding while preserving bundled, generated and external agents.

Preserve capability attenuation, manual/scheduled trigger policy and current-revision invalidation. Donor three-capability registry and empty isolation registry cannot restrict existing authorized tools/remote execution.

capabilities.capability: Owner skill libraries and command expansion
capabilities.required_adaptation: Add applicability/aliases/history/enable-disable-delete and explicit selected revision/digest binding. Preserve existing procedural skill packs and recipes.

Add profession/goal/preference/workflow_tag/context notes, correction/search/expiry/enable-disable/Forget and encrypted current-value binding. Keep existing memory/personalization; donor live memory qualification is not complete.

capabilities.capability: Deterministic guidance selection and dispatch fences
capabilities.required_adaptation: Bound combined skill/note expansion; recheck selected current revisions/expiry and bindings at dispatch/approval. Guidance never becomes authority or verified evidence.
Reuse owner and admin system records with existing no-cross-fallback policy. Preserve provider breadth and encrypted/redacted settings. Origin-bound key reuse is an additional design concern.

capabilities.capability: Optional local model and bounded transport
capabilities.required_adaptation: Qualify optional local Qwen profile/accounting and subprocess transport cleanup within existing provider seams. Donor custom providers cannot generate; that limitation cannot disable existing Deep providers.

capabilities.capability: Institutional IAM, sessions and native identity
capabilities.required_adaptation: Reuse institutional Astral realm/sub, existing BFF and native client ids. Reconcile strict donor audience/current-IAM reads and logout semantics; no donor user/session import or competing cookie store.

capabilities.capability: Scoped framework credentials and unattended consent
capabilities.required_adaptation: Add interactive issue/list/revoke, hashed secret, bounded allowance/expiry and provenance with final authority fence. Framework credentials never replace RFC8693 downstream authority or exact user approval.

capabilities.capability: REST interoperability and canonical read models
capabilities.required_adaptation: Expose/adapt operation/event/artifact/agent/tool/credential APIs and read schemas through one command boundary. Approval/reconciliation/settings stay nondelegable; private stream delivery remains current-authority checked.

capabilities.capability: MCP discovery, tool calls and legacy sessions
capabilities.required_adaptation: Adopt supported discover/initialize/list/call and exact-credential legacy sessions. Coordinate old astral-mcp JWT audience versus donor opaque credential; no weaker fallback.
Adopt SendMessage/SendStreamingMessage/GetTask/ListTasks/CancelTask/SubscribeToTask and human-input projection; explicitly refuse unsupported operations and preserve old integrations.

capabilities.capability: Sync/async Python SDK and stdio bridge
capabilities.required_adaptation: Adopt sync/async clients, same-key submission, revision-pinned controls, polling/SSE, bounded retry and owner-action stops. Qualify packaging and fixed-destination stdio bridge.
Track generic tools, OpenAI Agents, Anthropic/Claude, LangChain/LangGraph, CrewAI, PydanticAI and Microsoft/AutoGen wrappers separately. Source examples are not executed integrations.

capabilities.capability: Calmer task shell, navigation and owner-scoped drafts
capabilities.required_adaptation: Deliver one composer/recent work/result surface with progressive disclosure. Preserve reachable old tools; fix draft owner boundary and public-config bootstrap race. No mandatory ordinary-work preview.

capabilities.integration_owner: Projection; Deep; Primitives if approved definition required
capabilities.required_adaptation: Retain operations/details, agents/editor/history, artifacts/details, provider, grants, credentials, skills, memories, schedules, usage and admin diagnostics. Recompose forms once on server.

capabilities.capability: Semantic UI validation, adaptation and generated contracts
capabilities.integration_owner: Primitives defines; Projection renders/adapts; Deep composes
capabilities.required_adaptation: Map nine donor components and generic settings/actions onto existing rich vocabulary. Preserve rich media/data primitives and shape/depth/size/Unicode/style refusal, server-owned handoffs and one contract source.

capabilities.capability: Operation measurements, usage and admin diagnostics
capabilities.required_adaptation: Map owner timing/history and fixed-label admin counters. Preserve privacy/retention, unknown cost/coverage and overlapping/cutoff semantics. Diagnostic events grant no permission.

capabilities.capability: Security, audit provenance and outbound policy
capabilities.required_adaptation: Preserve owner isolation, taint/PHI, consent, egress, bounds and hash-chained audit. Donor public-data-only admission cannot erase clinical workflows or substitute for their PHI controls.

capabilities.capability: Durable storage, guarded upgrade and deletion
capabilities.required_adaptation: Translate additive schema semantics to Plane registry/pinned digest; preserve old data/recovery. Never run donor SQLAlchemy registry against Deep storage; no donor database import.

Adopt readiness/shutdown/cleanup and backup/recovery verification into existing topology. Standalone ports, bundled Keycloak/accounts and donor secrets bootstrap are source evidence only; never replay on institutional IAM.
Adopt narrow/wide, keyboard/focus/screen-reader/reduced-motion/200-percent-text behavior and safe PWA caching/updates. Caches cannot leak private responses or resurrect other-owner drafts.
Keep current PySide6 compatibility at web milestone; port donor operation/guidance/settings/current-state behavior and qualify redesigned Windows separately. Keep astral-desktop IAM.
Keep current Compose compatibility at web milestone; port donor semantics and qualify Android build/accessibility/live journeys separately. Keep astral-mobile IAM/redirect.

capabilities.capability: Apple and wrist redesigned native experience
capabilities.required_adaptation: Preserve iOS/macOS/watchOS current behavior; adopt adapted semantic content, secure auth and server-owned handoffs. Native redesign/live evidence remains open after web release.

capabilities.capability: Evidence, drift guards and release qualification
capabilities.integration_owner: All component owners; protected release verifier
capabilities.required_adaptation: Keep donor evidence identities separate; run integrated golden/denial/failure/recovery, changed-line coverage and live client/provider/IAM gates. No fixture, scan or web milestone closes the full feature.

primary_review_defects.title: Revoked authority can issue a framework credential
primary_review_defects.trigger: Issuing credential revoked after current-authority check, before owner-locked write.
primary_review_defects.donor_review_evidence: 201 issuance; new 90-day token reads with 200 while original reads with 401.
primary_review_defects.required_correction: Repeat local credential/owner/expiry check with fresh time after owner lock before issuance.

primary_review_defects.title: Composer draft crosses owner boundary
primary_review_defects.trigger: Owner A leaves prompt/sources, signs out; B signs in in same tab.
primary_review_defects.donor_review_evidence: Real session/prefs modules restore A draft under B in synthetic owner switch.
primary_review_defects.required_correction: Bind draft to verified owner; erase on logout/verified change; preserve appropriate same-owner recovery.

primary_review_defects.title: Held schedules starve later owners
primary_review_defects.trigger: Ten oldest schedules have outstanding budget-blocked episodes.
primary_review_defects.donor_review_evidence: Another owner ready schedule stays zero runs across three ticks; direct normal admission succeeds.
primary_review_defects.required_correction: Bounded fair scan/rotation or eligibility-aware selection preserving authoritative admission.

primary_review_defects.title: Ephemeral research evidence lost on model retry
primary_review_defects.trigger: memory_policy=none; source fetch succeeds, then one non-consuming provider_unavailable.
primary_review_defects.donor_review_evidence: retry_eligible becomes source_unavailable with one fetch/one model attempt despite healthy provider on retry.
primary_review_defects.required_correction: Refetch transient evidence under remaining budgets without durable retention.

primary_review_defects.title: Public config discarded after identity completes
primary_review_defects.trigger: Parallel public config completes after identity changes session generation.
primary_review_defects.donor_review_evidence: Live signed-out warning despite 200 endpoints; delayed-config module repro leaves config=null/error.
primary_review_defects.required_correction: Sequence public bootstrap or separate genuinely public response handling; retain private generation fences.

additional_design_concerns.title: Retained provider keys across origin changes
additional_design_concerns.evidence: Real API/MockTransport sent prior synthetic key to new provider host; donor form documents blank-preserve behavior. Separate from five primary regressions.
additional_design_concerns.disposition: Specify origin-bound reuse or explicit reentry; preserve encryption/redaction.

iam_reuse.local_config_evidence: Allowlisted public fields; USE_MOCK_AUTH=false; secret presence only, no values retained.

public_discovery_evidence.result: Successful unauthenticated GET; exact issuer and token/JWKS/introspection/revocation/logout/device endpoints; S256 supported.
public_discovery_evidence.limitation: No client-registration, mapper, privilege or authenticated verification.

iam_reuse.mapping: Existing institutional verified sub remains ownership key; no donor subjects/usernames imported.
required_reconciliation: One BFF boundary; donor and Deep use incompatible astral_session formats.
Existing authorized-party versus donor strict astral-api audience; discover mappers before changes.
If adopted, donor current-IAM reads require separate least-privilege view-users authority account; no admin changes authorized here.
Retain RFC8693 delegation, astral-mcp audience and tool/PHI/egress/approval gates.
Never run donor realm/account bootstrap against institutional IAM.

provider_reuse.rule: Owner user_llm_config for interactive work; separate admin system_llm_config for system context; no cross-fallback. Plane owns encryption/storage.
provider_reuse.selected_endpoint_model: Deployment metadata not read; discover through existing authorized repository/API seams, not environment keys.
provider_reuse.disposition: Optional local inference adds capability and cannot impose donor single-model restriction.

review_evidence.portability: Local report is not tracked source; findings/anchors/failure conditions retained here.
review_evidence.security_command: .venv/Scripts/python.exe -B -m pytest tests/test_api_auth.py tests/test_current_authority.py tests/test_grant_delegation_security.py tests/test_egress_security.py tests/test_storage_audit_security.py tests/test_stream_authority.py -q
review_evidence.limitation: Donor-only counts; independent five failure reproductions coexist. No integrated institutional IAM, production/native/human qualification claimed.

evidence_rules.source_present: Frozen source only; not passing tests or live verification.
evidence_rules.donor_reported: Historical source-reported evidence cannot close integration.
evidence_rules.donor_reproduced: Concrete reviewer reproduction cannot prove integrated correction.
evidence_rules.closure: Every capability, retained group and API/UI/SDK behavior plus source FR requires verified disposition. Web completion cannot erase native redesign.

validation.api_method: AST literal FastAPI decorators plus verified /api/interop/v1 factory prefix and six explicit protocol registrations; donor surface mapping, not duplicate integrated routes.
validation.sdk_method: AST public classes/methods plus tool catalog and complete adapter/example manifests; no runtime imports.
